scope.title: Finite-state circuit breaker for abnormal call rates

decision.reason: Added a deterministic finite-state rate breaker (closed/open/half-open) with cooldown and a single half-open probe. A legal rate never trips; an open breaker refuses during cooldown; the probe either closes or re-opens with a fresh cooldown; window pruning prevents false trips.

breaker.closed: requests allowed; failures counted in a sliding window; crossing maxFailuresPerWindow -> open
breaker.open: allowsRequest() false during cooldown (no further effect); after cooldown -> half-open
breaker.half-open: exactly one probe admitted; clean probe -> closed; failed probe -> open with a fresh cooldown
breaker.legalRate: no failures -> never trips; sliding window prunes stale failures
breaker.coexistsWith: guardian-circuit-breaker (blocking-signal counting) - this adds the time dimension; does not relax SSRF/loop guard/approval

residual.assembly: The breaker core is provided; wiring it to a concrete provider/run call site is integration-layer work.
residual.scope: A boundary/limit, not a production default; does not relax SSRF/loop guard/approval and does not duplicate the existing outbound budget.

independentVerification.detail: Tests drive the real breaker with an injected clock across legal-rate, trip, cooldown, half-open single-probe, recovery and window-pruning cases, and run alongside the tool-loop-detection regression to show the existing guard is unaffected. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Closed/open/half-open state machine, deterministic under an injected clock.
Requests are refused during the cooldown (no further effect) and only then move to half-open.
Exactly one half-open probe is admitted; a second is refused while it is in flight.
A clean probe closes the breaker; a failed probe re-opens it with a fresh cooldown.
A purely legal rate never trips; sliding-window pruning prevents false trips in later legal windows.
No SSRF/loop-guard/approval change; complements the existing blocking-signal guardian breaker and the outbound budget.
6 new + 31 loop-guard regression tests pass, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Wiring into a concrete provider/run call site.
